title: Khanom Krok
description: Khanom Krok is a dish from Thailand prepared with rice flour, coconut milk, pandan leaves, green onion. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Pandan leaves are infused rather than using pandan extract; a round-cavity skillet makes the characteristic shape.

steps.instruction: Whisk the listed batter ingredients until smooth. Let the mixture rest briefly so the flour hydrates.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Cook the coconut-rice batter in a khanom krok or takoyaki pan with small round wells, covering briefly so each cake sets with crisp edges.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
